grid_land_mask.rule: Grid cells with land fraction >= 50% (Natural Earth 110m, land_fraction.json) are land, the rest ocean; cos(lat)-weighted mean of observed cells; null if < 40% of the class area is observed. APPROXIMATE: GISTEMP and HadCRUT5 cells blend land stations and SST, and coastal cells mix both.

land_ocean.note: GISTEMP 'land-only' is the meteorological-station series (Ts) and 'land-ocean' is the blended series (Ts+dSST). The gap is NOT an ocean series: neither product used here publishes an ocean-only index, and the land series covers fewer cells. AR6 values are shown only as published context (1850-1900 baseline, different datasets).

method: Cell annual anomalies are rebased per cell (offset = cell mean of annual values over the baseline, >= 80% of reference years required), then averaged with cos(latitude) weights over the observed cells of the band. A band-year with < 40% of its area observed is null. Band edges are multiples of 10 degrees (whole cells on both grids).
